text:
Ava Chen: Quick thread — prep for next month's webinar + benchmark narrative. Goal: make the unit-economics story front-and-center (tokens -> $) while still showing the latency/throughput tradeoffs. Need 3 chart hypotheses, short positioning bullets for startups vs enterprise, and a concrete inbound routing plan for leads. Can we sketch this out?

Jonah Patel: +1. Three-chart idea I like: 1) cost-per-1M tokens vs model family (bars, normalized), 2) latency CDF by deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private) for 10k prompt distribution, 3) throughput curves showing tokens/sec at target p95 SLOs. Short and scannable.

Samira Rao: For chart 1, propose buckets: <2B, 2–20B, 20–70B, 70B+. Use median quantized costs (with error bars). Callout: quantization & batching assumptions under the bars.

Maya Li: Messaging tweak: for startups highlight "predictable per-request pricing + easy burst capacity". For enterprise: "SLA-backed latency + deterministic unit economics for budgeting". Two one-line taglines we can A/B test on landing page.

Evan Brooks: Inbound routing: funnel rules we should consider — webinar registrants who run the benchmark kit -> SDR follow-up (warm). Non-runner registrants -> automated drip with 3 short case studies (startup/PLG/enterprise). Also capture which deployment they selected in the kit (hosted/dedicated/private) and route accordingly.

Ava Chen: Love it. Can someone draft the chart copy (headlines + 1-sentence takeaways) so design can mock? Also need a 90-sec demo script that aligns to the charts.

Samira Rao: I'll do chart copy. Draft headlines: "Spending transparency: cost per 1M tokens across model families" (takeaway: quantization + batching = up to 6x savings). "Latency that scales: p95 latency by deployment mode" (takeaway: Dedicated gives consistent tail behavior). "Throughput economics: tokens/sec at target SLO" (takeaway: route to cheaper variants under load to save 30–50%).

Jonah Patel: For design, add a tiny panel under chart 1 showing an example calc: 
```
Example: 1M tokens = 2000 calls at avg 500 tokens -> Hosted baseline $X -> With batching+quantize ~ $X/3
```
Keep numbers illustrative.

Maya Li: For landing CTA variants: 
- Variant A (startups): "Run a free micro-benchmark — see your tokens-to-cost in <5min"
- Variant B (enterprise): "Request a capacity consult — predictable pricing & SLAs"
We should map CTR -> follow-up path.

Evan Brooks: Metrics to track post-webinar: run-the-kit conversion rate, MQL->SQL velocity, demo requests by deployment preference. Also track time-to-first-run (we want <24h).

bench-bot: Summary created: https://internal.redwood/bench/unit-econ-summary (automated). Attachments: stub CSV with sample cost numbers, chart specs. :robot_face:

Ava Chen: Perfect. Owners: Samira = chart copy + sample CSV (due Wed), Jonah = design mocks (Thu), Maya = CTA copy + routing rules (Thu), Evan = tracking spec + SDR playbook (Fri). I'll draft the 90s demo script and post v1 by EOD. Anything missing?

Jonah Patel: Can we include a tiny section on "graceful degradation" — show how fallbacks reduce cost spikes without breaking SLO. Quick 1-liner for chart 3.

Maya Li: Good call. Add a secondary callout: "Fallbacks keep things online and save you ~$ per spike" (we'll get exacts from Samira).

Ava Chen: Great — thanks team. I'll stitch this into the webinar outline once Samira's numbers come in. :thumbsup:
